title: Source Coverage and Citation Bias in LLM-based vs. Traditional Search Engines

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing source selection patterns by measuring domain concentration (Gini index), domain overlap between search engines, and source popularity (Tranco rankings) to identify preferences for specific websites and structural HTML characteristics.

Mapping cited domain sources to Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC) ratings to calculate the mean political leaning scores of the search results and identify ideological skews (e.g., left-leaning tendencies).
Using Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC) factual-reporting ratings to evaluate the reliability of cited sources, and analyzing the proportion of malicious or unsafe domains surfaced using VirusTotal.
